title: Why the 5th slot???
content: The game play is fun, and actually kinda challenging which I was surprised by, but the 3 stars are because the game has 5 storage slots to keep fish that you have selected and are not being used, but the moment you fill the 5th slot the game ends. The first time this happened I used it to pop a bubble and the fish I was looking for came down, but it didn’t matter because the game ended. Never have I seen in a game an ornamental storage slots that might as well be called the game over slot. If the developers intended for you to only use 4 storage slots then only put 4. Many games have it to where you use the final storage space, the game waits a second and if it’s not possible to win the game will end. I do not see why the same mechanic cannot be used here.

author: Lucy1129
title: Hidden Timer for Order Expired
content: Got several levels into this game and was enjoying it when suddenly I started getting kicked out of a level with an “ORDER EXPIRED” notice.   Sometimes this would happen several times as I tried to progress in the level, and each time I would be required to watch an ad to proceed in the level.   The problem is that the App keeps it’s timer HIDDEN so there’s no way to know when you’re approaching a timeout.   SO even someone like me, who was foolish enough to pay for NO ADS, is being forced to sit through ads in order to finish a level.   This is DIRTY POOL period.   I would ask to be refunded for that $7.99 no ads shakedown, but I suspect the aggro is not worth the bother.   AVOID unless you don’t mind being forced, mid level, to watch several ads.

author: Rissa2real
title: Okay Game
content:
I really enjoyed this game until I realized you can never actually buy the extra fish bowls permanently.

I watched ads to double my coins and finally saved up enough to “buy” the third fish bowl. After I purchased it, I found out it was ONLY for the level I was currently playing. It wasn’t mine to keep for future levels. When the next level started, I was literally wondering, “Where is the fish bowl I just bought?” That was extremely disappointing and honestly felt misleading, so I deleted the game.

As far as the ads go, I personally only had to watch them when I wanted to use an extra fish bowl or one of the advantages. But some of the advantages were basically useless.

The “Refresh” option was especially frustrating. I watched three ads to refresh three different times, and it gave me the SAME exact fish every single time.

The fish “Net” advantage wasn’t much better. It kept giving me the same fish I already had, which meant I had to keep watching more ads just to use the net again and store fish in the holding slots.

I liked the game itself, but the way the extra bowls and advantages work completely ruined it for me. If I spend coins to purchase an extra fish bowl, I should be able to KEEP it—not lose it after one level.

The moment you put a fish in the 5th space, the game is over, even if putting a fish in that 5th space made available to fish you need to clear a fish bowl. So the 5th space is absolutely useless.
